theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Rise on CoreWeave Results, Bonds Drop: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks rose in early trading after better-than-expected earnings from CoreWeave Inc. eased concerns over the outlook for the artificial intelligence trade, helping counter a Wall Street selloff fueled by hotter-than-expected US inflation.

top_news.title: China’s Copper Crunch Puts Industry on Defensive as Costs Soar
top_news.summary: China’s copper crunch is squeezing activity and margins at the firms that shape the metal into wires, rods and tubes for use in products from cables to electronics and consumer goods.

top_news.title: Breaking Down Anthropic's $1.4 Trillion IPO Valuation
top_news.summary: Anthropic is preparing to price its initial public offering on November 18, targeting a fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion and raising up to $90.4 billion to fund computing capacity for frontier AI models. Bloomberg’s Michael Shepard discusses the deal structure and whether the artificial intelligence sector can be said to have a circular financing dynamic. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Nvidia Turmoil Raises Stakes for the US-China Tech Rivalry
top_news.summary: "Insight with Haslinda Amin" is a daily news program featuring in-depth, high-profile interviews and analysis to give viewers the complete picture on the stories that matter. The show features prominent leaders spanning the worlds of business, finance, politics and culture. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Equity Dispersion Trade Risks a Blowup, Hedge Fund CEO Warns
top_news.summary: Investors enjoying a golden era for the equity dispersion trade should be braced for pain if the market shifts suddenly, according to a hedge fund manager.

top_news.title: Dollar’s Reliance on Equity Inflows Seen Weighing on Currency
top_news.summary: The dollar’s increasing dependence on equity inflows could erode the diversification benefit of leaving US assets unhedged, according to Deutsche Bank AG strategists, potentially putting downward pressure on the currency over time.

top_news.title: Gold Holds Loss Near $4,000 on Hot US Inflation, Fed Remarks
top_news.summary: Gold maintained losses after a high US inflation print and hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve officials reinforced bets for an interest rate hike in December.

top_news.title: At China’s Big Import Fair, Sellers Try to Crack a Tough Market

top_news.title: OpenTable CEO on 2027 Dining Trends Report
top_news.summary: OpenTable CEO Debby Soo says diners continue to value restaurant experiences despite economic pressures, with Gen Z especially inclined to go out for celebrations and smaller special occasions. The 2027 dining trends report says 68% of diners expect to eat out the same amount or more, rising to 88% among Gen Z. Soo speaks with Vonnie Quinn & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Anthropic IPO Explained: Nasdaq Listing and Key Risks
top_news.summary: In late 2020, a group of senior OpenAI employees unhappy with what they saw as the company’s failure to adequately prioritize AI ethics and safety left the firm to form Anthropic PBC. Just a few years later, the younger company has become an artificial intelligence behemoth that is expected to hold one of the largest initial public offerings in history.
